name: eInvoice (WEBUILD)
description: WEBUILD eInvoice attestation: EN 16931 invoice fields as SD-JWT VC claims, bound to the invoice document by its hash.
summary: Credential type template for WEBUILD's eInvoice attestation (vct eu.we-build:einvoice:1, sd_jwt_vc), following the consortium's eInvoice SD-JWT data schema: seller and buyer as objects with their EUID and VAT identifiers, amounts as decimal strings, tax subtotals, payment instructions and evidence references. It binds to the invoice document by invoicePayloadHash rather than embedding it. Issued by the supplier to the manufacturer over WMP and never published, as in workflows/dpp-workflow.md (noop/dpp_supplier).
